name: Aniyome Aya to Nakadashi Kozukuri Nikki
original_name: 兄嫁彩と中出し子作り日記
source:
Keisuke coveted his older brother's wife. One night at dinner his brother revealed that he was infertile. 
I can't father a child, said the drunken brother through slurred speech, we even went to a clinic. 

Then he passed out. Beautiful wife Aya tidied up. 
Keisuke saw an opportunity. Emboldened with booze he followed her into the kitchen, 
and ravished his brother's wife then and there. 

The next day Keisuke felt regret too powerful to face them. 
He steered clear of his brother's house. 
But when he got home, Aya was waiting. 

"Keisuke-kun... make a baby inside me......!" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139034.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
圭介一直觊觎哥哥的妻子。一天晚上吃饭时，哥哥说自己没有生育能力。
“我没法当父亲，”喝醉的哥哥含糊地说，“我们甚至还去过诊所。”

说完他便昏睡过去。美丽的妻子彩收拾好东西。圭介看到了机会，借着酒劲跟进厨房，当场蹂躏了哥哥的妻子。

第二天，圭介感到后悔，强烈到无法面对他们，于是避开了哥哥家。
但他回到家时，彩正在等他。

“圭介君……在我体内制造一个孩子吧……！”

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139034.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
